attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. saint.gr keeps a Carterius who was a presbyter of Caesarea in Cappadocia on 8 Ιανουαρίου, and the corpus holds him as `carterius-of-caesarea`; the two are separate entries on the same calendar and this folder records only the 5 Νοεμβρίου one, the companion of Eupsychius.
